TA0009.title: Malicious Merchants
TA0009.description: Malicious merchants are commercial entities or individuals engaged in fraud, deception, or other illegitimate means to profit. They use false advertising, deceptive pricing, fictitious goods or services, counterfeit or substandard products, and unfair transaction practices to mislead consumers. Some create fabricated refund transactions for illicit cash-out or participate in online scams, fraudulent ad clicks, and order manipulation, harming consumers and the integrity of the digital economy.
